jobs.title: EverHealth: Director of Onboarding + Implementation
jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 690,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/


We are looking for a **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** at **EverHealth** to join our Customer Experience leadership team. EverHealth is simplifying the business of healthcare through simplified, user\-centric software which streamlines the daily operations of healthcare practices. Our EHR and billing solutions give small and medium\-sized practices an integrated ecosystem of intuitive, easy\-to\-use products that work with how providers run and grow their business.


**About the Role**


We're seeking an operational and visionary **Director of Onboarding \& Implementation** to lead the team that gets new EverHealth customers live on our EHR and billing products. This role owns the customer journey from signed contract through go\-live and early adoption for a high\-volume base of small and medium\-sized practices, delivered almost entirely without onsite implementation. You will be equally comfortable setting the long\-term vision for how onboarding should work at EverHealth and rolling up your sleeves to redesign a workflow, resolve an escalation, or coach a team member through a difficult go\-live.


Your north star is time to first value: how quickly and reliably a new practice experiences the outcomes they bought our software to achieve. You will also evolve the team's approach from software training to consultative practice partnership — helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it. Reporting to the VP of Customer Experience, this role will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership to shape how EverHealth brings new customers into the fold.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Vision \& Strategy:** Define and evangelize a multi\-year vision for onboarding and implementation at EverHealth, translating it into a concrete roadmap across the EHR and billing product lines.
* **Time to First Value:** Own time\-to\-first\-value as the team's primary metric, redesigning milestones, workflows, and staffing models to shorten it without compromising quality.
* **Continuing the Sale:** Partner with Sales to treat onboarding as an extension of the buying journey — reinforcing the original value proposition and building momentum for retention and expansion from day one.
* **Consultative Transformation:** Shift the team's operating model from feature training to consultative, workflow\-based implementation, coaching specialists to diagnose a practice's operations and recommend how to run it on EverHealth, not just how to use it.
* **Cross\-Product Coordination:** Simplifying onboarding motions across multiple product/feature adoptions (payments, RCM, etc) to one coordinated implementation rather than two disconnected projects.
* **Remote\-First Delivery Model:** Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a high\-volume book of small and medium\-sized practices, reserving onsite engagement for the rare exception.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead a team of managers and help support ongoing development of the existing management team and frontline specialists, building career paths that reward consultative skill as much as technical proficiency.
* **Process \& Playbook Development:** Create repeatable playbooks, journey maps, and tooling, powered by AI, that let the team scale efficiently as customer volume grows, without sacrificing a tailored feel for each practice.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Sales to close feedback loops, resolve systemic issues, and ensure a seamless handoff at every stage of the customer lifecycle.
* **Performance Measurement:** Define, track, and report on key onboarding metrics (e.g., time to first value, time to go\-live, onboarding CSAT, adoption at 30/60/90 days) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* **Escalation Management:** Serve as an executive point of escalation for at\-risk implementations, working cross\-functionally to get stalled onboardings back on track.

**Skills \& Experience**


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years leading Onboarding, Implementation, or Professional Services teams in SaaS, including at least 3\+ years in a director\-level or equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience building or scaling a high\-volume, remote\-first onboarding model for small and medium\-sized customers, not a heavy onsite/enterprise implementation environment.
* Track record of shifting a team's approach from transactional training to consultative, outcomes\-based customer engagement, driven by AI and foundational digital\-led content to optimize the experience.
* Deep fluency in time\-to\-value, adoption, and onboarding health metrics, with the ability to translate data into operational change.
* Experience managing onboarding across multiple, distinct products or workflows simultaneously.
* Strong executive presence and cross\-functional influence, with the ability to partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes, playbooks, and tooling from the ground up.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR, practice management, or medical billing/revenue cycle management software.
* Background in healthcare technology, digital health, or working with small and medium\-sized healthcare practices.
* Experience navigating HIPAA\-compliant environments or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Smartsheet, or similar).
* MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.

**Where:** \[this is a remote role, however, proximity to Denver, CO is a plus. Given the team's remote\-first delivery model, travel is minimal — occasional travel for company or team on\-sites]


The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in\-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


**Benefits and Perks** (JUST U.S.):


* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid
* Robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Student Loan Repayment Program

**Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 \- $190,000 USD per year with an incentive variable in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Remote position: must reside in the Orlando, Osceola, Polk , or Brevard markets\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: IT Analyst Senior - EMR Lab IT
jobs.description:
UVA Medical Center Category Information Management, Services \& Technology Location Charlottesville, Virginia, United States of America Partially Remote Job Id R0085586
  
Help power the technology behind exceptional patient care. As a senior member of UVA Health's Lab IT team, you will support the critical laboratory systems, analyzers, middleware platforms, and clinical integrations that enable accurate, timely diagnostic services across a leading academic health system.


This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare technology, laboratory informatics, and systems integration in a highly visible role. You'll work alongside experienced technical and laboratory professionals while contributing to major modernization initiatives that directly impact laboratory operations and patient outcomes.


**The Role**


As a Senior IT Analyst supporting EMR and Laboratory IT, you will serve as a key contributor supporting the technologies that connect laboratory analyzers, middleware applications, Point\-of\-Care systems, Blood Bank platforms, and Epic integrations across UVA Health. This role is ideal for a healthcare IT professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, supporting critical operations, and participating in large\-scale technology implementations.


In a typical day, you may:


* Support laboratory analyzers, automation platforms, and middleware environments.
* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory interfaces and system integrations.
* Investigate analyzer connectivity, workflow, and data transmission issues.
* Provide support for Point\-of\-Care technologies throughout the health system.
* Assist with Blood Bank application support and related laboratory technologies.
* Support laboratory desktops, printers, scanners, and associated equipment.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing activities, implementations, and go\-live support.
* Develop and support workflows, configurations, and rules within Data Innovations and related middleware technologies.
* Collaborate closely with laboratory leaders, clinicians, vendors, and operational teams to ensure reliable system performance.
This position offers exposure to a dynamic environment where technology, clinical operations, and patient care intersect every day. You'll have the opportunity to influence major projects while continuing to expand your expertise in specialized laboratory systems.


**Why UVA Health**


UVA Health is a nationally recognized academic health system that combines leading\-edge clinical care, groundbreaking research, and innovative technology to improve the lives of patients across Virginia and beyond. This role plays a vital part in supporting mission\-critical laboratory operations that clinicians depend upon every day.


What makes this opportunity stand out:


* **Direct involvement in a major laboratory relocation project**, including analyzer deployment, testing, validation, and operational readiness activities.
* **Participation in a large\-scale laboratory automation modernization effort**, providing valuable implementation and post\-production experience.
* **Hands\-on exposure to Abbott AMS**, next\-generation middleware technology that will shape the future of laboratory operations.
* **Opportunity to work with Data Innovations, Epic integrations, Point\-of\-Care technologies, Blood Bank applications, and advanced laboratory automation platforms.**
* **Mentorship from highly experienced professionals** with decades of laboratory systems and healthcare IT expertise.
* **Strong career growth potential** for professionals seeking to deepen their knowledge of laboratory informatics and healthcare technology.
* **Collaborative leadership and team culture** that values learning, knowledge sharing, and employee development.
* **Meaningful impact on patient care** through reliable technology solutions that support clinicians, laboratories, and healthcare operations.
* Hybrid flexibility with onsite engagement when business and operational needs require.
* Additional compensation provided for participation in the on\-call rotation.
* **Relocation** **assistance** **may be available for qualified candidates.**
Whether your background includes laboratory middleware, analyzer support, healthcare IT, clinical systems, or interface development, this position offers a rare opportunity to build highly specialized expertise within one of the region's leading health systems.


**Why People Love Living in Charlottesville**


Charlottesville offers an exceptional quality of life that is difficult to match. Nestled in the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains, the area combines scenic beauty, outdoor recreation, vibrant arts and culture, outstanding restaurants, wineries, and a welcoming community atmosphere. Residents enjoy easy access to hiking, cycling, and nearby national parks while benefiting from the energy of a thriving university town. For professionals and families alike, Charlottesville provides the ideal balance of career opportunity, affordability, education, and lifestyle, making it one of Virginia's most desirable places to call home.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:


Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or an equivalent combination of accreditation, education and experience required.


Experience: 5\+ years relevant professional experience required.


Licensure: None.


Preferred: Knowledge or experience with digital pathology systems, scanners, image\-management platforms, workflows, interfaces, or supporting infrastructure.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:


This is primarily a sedentary job involving extensive use of desktop computers. The job does occasionally require traveling some distance to attend meetings, and programs.


The pay range for this role is $39\.77 \- $79\.54 hourly. Individual compensation will be determined by the selected candidate's qualifications, previous work experience, and/or education.
**Benefits**


* Comprehensive Benefits Package: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off, Long\-term and Short\-term Disability, Retirement Savings
* Health Saving Plans, and Flexible Spending Accounts
* Certification and education support
* Generous Paid Time Off

UVA Health is a world\-class Magnet Recognized academic medical center and health system with a level 1 trauma center. 2023\-2024 U.S. News \& World Report “Best Hospitals” guide rates UVA Health University Medical Center as “High Performing” in 5 adult specialties and 14 conditions/procedures. We are one of 70 National Cancer Institute designated cancer centers. UVA Health Children’s is named by 2023\-2024 U.S. News \& World Report as the best children's hospital in Virginia with 9 specialties ranked among the best in the nation. Our footprint also encompasses 3 community hospitals and an integrated network of primary and specialty care clinics throughout Charlottesville, Culpeper, Northern Virginia, and beyond.


*The University of Virginia is an equal opportunity employer. All interested persons are encouraged to apply, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. Learn more about* *UVA’s commitment to non\-discrimination and equal opportunity employment**.*


  
**Company** UVA Medical Center
**Hiring Type** Full time
**Remote Type** Partially Remote

jobs.title: Senior Technology Learning & Adoption Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Cooley is seeking a Senior Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist to join the Technology Client Services Department.

**Position summary**: Cooley Technology embraces a culture of customer service excellence and all members of the department are expected to move this agenda forward. To that end, the Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist is expected to recognize that the Cooley Technology department is a service organization first and foremost and will be evaluated on this requirement equal in importance to the technical or operational responsibilities outlined later in this document.


The Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist consults and partners with key stakeholders and peers to create, implement and deliver learning strategies that develop technology\-related skills in order to enhance the firm’s performance and efficiency. This role will work with peers on the Technology Learning \& Adoption team, as well as other groups within the firm, to prioritize the Technology training workload and determine learning strategy. The Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist will assist in assembling learning and development materials into curricula and training programs that serve attorneys and business professionals. This role is also responsible for updating and curating current training materials and researching and finding new sources of ready\-made training content. The Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist is responsible for delivering new hire training and other classes, in physical and virtual classroom environments, to all personnel.


A Technology Learning \& Adoption Training Specialist has strong consultation skills, is an innovative problem solver, has the ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities, works well with others and can establish credibility at all levels of the organization through communication, knowledge and professional presence. The Specialist is able to identify the most efficient and effective adult learning methods to deliver intended content. Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

**Position responsibilities:**


* Act as a coach in building the skills and abilities of personnel, both inside and outside of the classroom
* Create educational resources and provide educational support related to an array of technical products, including Windows, Microsoft Office and other Cooley financial and legal applications
* Design learning solutions including instructor\-led courses, videos, and written documentation
* Transform scripts, storyboards and course plans into activities that promote learner information retention and engagement
* Maintain existing training resources and look for new ways to utilize them. Retire resources when they become irrelevant
* Facilitate technology\-related classes for all roles within the firm
* Accurately diagnose organizational technology performance issues and recommend the most appropriate solutions
* Consult with Technology management, HR and Administration, as well as individual users to anticipate and understand needs and develop customized learning solutions including facilitated training, coaching, videos, guides, and other resources
* Build trust and work effectively with all firm users.
* Participate in complex projects and/or project teams; develop training materials aligned to project plans with key activities, milestones, stakeholders, and rollout strategies; ensure execution and measure effectiveness
* Manage a workload consisting of on\-demand, critical and highly visible projects as well as ongoing operational and administrative tasks
* Schedule training and maintain records of student registration and course completion using the firm's learning management system. Receive and address training\-related requests via the ticket management system
* Ensure that best practices and procedures are relayed to new and existing personnel with regular follow\-up
* Serve as a conduit for customer feedback to improve systems and procedures
* Work with other Technology groups to create and maintain documentation for firm IS products
* Assist Technology groups with QA efforts related to firm technology
* Keep apprised of all changes to firm technology. Research and remain educated on industry and company trends
* All other duties as assigned or required

**Skills and experience**:


Required:

* After orientation at Cooley LLP, exhibit proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, iManage and other firm applications
* Available to work overtime, as required
* Available to travel, as needed
* 4\+ years' experience with software systems and successful participation and coordinating training projects in a business setting
* Prior instructional design and curriculum development experience delivering technology\-related material
* Ability to develop learning objectives and competency requirements, reference guides, instructor\-led materials and evaluations/assessments
* Understanding of techniques used to facilitate adult learning
* Prior in\-person and virtual classroom experience teaching technology\-related material


Preferred:

* Bachelor's degree in a field related to education, technology or business
* Prior technical writing or visual design experience
* Knowledge of video recording/editing software commonly used in learning and development
* Experience recording voiceover or filming oneself in the context of creating learning materials
* Familiarity with the Microsoft Manual of Style
* Experience with learning management systems, learning development and virtual classroom tools
* Experience collaborating with a geographically dispersed team

**Competencies**:

* Willingness to adjust to organizational change and manage priorities effectively
* Fundamental commitment to customer service excellence
* Desire to be a lifelong learner
* Passion for creating blended learning programs
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Willingness to suggest solutions and improvements while maintaining a positive attitude
* Ability to learn and adhere to technical editing style protocols
* Experience with and a willingness to engage with personnel face\-to\-face and deliver impromptu one\-on\-one coaching
* Desire to proactively help other members of the Technology Learning \& Development team
* Ability to work independently, seek answers when needed, and motivate oneself and others
* Excellent project management skills, especially related to managing project scope, successfully managing time commitments, and fully utilizing available resources
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong organizational skills


Cooley offers a competitive compensation and excellent benefits package and is committed to fair and equitable employment practices.


EOE.


The expected hourly pay range for this position with a work schedule of 40 hours per week is $62\.00 \- 76\.00 ($128,960\.00 \- $158,080\.00 annually).


We offer a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre\-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD\&D, long\-term care coverage, backup care for children and/or adults and other parental support benefits. In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive firm\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as 20 days of Paid Time Off (“PTO”) and 10 paid holidays each year. We provide generous parental leave and fertility benefits. New employees will attend a detailed benefit orientation to learn more about our many benefits and resources.

jobs.title: POS Implementation & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**All Business Solutions** is seeking a bilingual (English/Spanish) POS Implementation \& Support Specialist with hands\-on experience supporting point\-of\-sale systems.

This is a customer\-facing technical and merchant\-operations role supporting primarily restaurants and hospitality and retail businesses with day\-to\-day POS issues, account maintenance, installations, onboarding, hardware, payment terminals, and merchant\-service requests.

This role is ideal for someone who combines technical ability with strong communication and customer service skills and is comfortable working directly with merchants in fast\-paced environments.

You will support a wide range of businesses, primarily restaurants—by installing, configuring, and supporting POS systems, ensuring a smooth onboarding and long\-term client experience, while also contributing to the ongoing rollout and evolution of **Salsa POS** as it moves toward full market deployment.

About the Role

● This is a hybrid role combining remote and onsite support.

● Specialist is responsible for:

● Installing and configuring POS systems

● Supporting onboarding and go\-live

● Troubleshooting issues in real time

● Training staff and operators

● You will work directly with business owners, managers, and staff, requiring clear communication, professionalism, and the ability to solve problems under pressure.

● This is not a traditional IT role. Respond to routine merchant questions and service requests with clear ownership from request through completion.

● It is a customer\-facing, operations\-focused position where communication and service are just as important as technical skills.

Responsibilities

● Learn and become proficient in the POS systems we support

● Install and configure POS hardware, including terminals, printers, and peripherals

● Support clients in basic merchant services, onboarding, training, and go\-live processes

● Provide both remote and on\-site support to merchants

● Troubleshoot POS software, hardware, and payment\-related issues

● Maintain accurate documentation and update tickets with clear notes and status

● Assist with staging and preparation of POS systems prior to deployment

● Communicate clearly with merchants to resolve issues efficiently

● Deliver a high level of customer service and maintain a positive client experience

Ideal Candidate

● Experience supporting POS systems (Required)

● Bilingual in English and Spanish (Required)

● Hospitality or restaurant experience (Preferred)

● Strong communication skills (critical for success in this role)

● Excellent customer service and ability to remain professional under pressure

● Ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve efficiently

● Highly organized with strong attention to detail

● Self\-motivated with a strong work ethic

● Comfortable working both remotely and onsite

● Tech\-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems

Compensation: $19–$25 per hour (based on relevant experience and demonstrated capability**.**)

Benefits

● Health Insurance

● 401(k) with company match (after 3 months)

● Performance\-based bonuses

● Paid holidays

● Paid birthday off

● 5 PTO days \+ 5 vacation days

● $20 monthly gym credit

● Company\-provided laptop

● Ongoing training and development

● Continuing education support

● Industry conferences and events

● Internal promotion pathways

● Team outings, celebrations, and company events

Pay: $19\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Have you personally installed or configured POS hardware such as terminals, printers, cash drawers, tablets, handhelds, routers, or payment devices?
* Have you handled day\-to\-day merchant support requests such as bank account changes, account updates, statements, funding/deposit questions, payment\-processing questions, or processor documentation?
* Have you worked with payment processors, merchant\-service providers, or payment terminals before?
* Which POS systems have you personally supported, installed, configured, or troubleshot?
* Are you fluent in both English and Spanish?

Experience:

* supporting POS systems: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English / Spanish (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Houston, TX 77070 (Required)

Work Location: In person
